key_insight: Reducing memory to delayed feedback enables optimistic constrained online optimization with guarantees that adapt to environmental change and prediction accuracy.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports stateful online learning and non-stochastic control with time-varying constraints, using potentially unreliable forecasts to improve theoretical performance.
method: Reduce memory effects to delay by treating state-dependent gradients as delayed feedback.
Incorporate untrusted predictions into optimistic constrained online optimization.
Adapt bounds to comparator path length and prediction accuracy without assuming functional separability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical guarantees, not empirical evaluation: perfect predictions yield O(1) regret, with cumulative constraint violation O(√T) for unknown path length or O(log T) when it is known or online observable.
watch_item: Stronger constraint-violation guarantees require known or online-observable path length; practical runtime and empirical robustness are not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Dynamic Optimistic Constrained OCO with Memory via Delay Equivalence
